claims.text: Fundin is one of the dwarf names found in the Völuspá. His name means "Found".
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien; Douglas A. Anderson, (ed.), (2002) The Annotated Hobbit: Revised and Expanded Edition, p. 316

claims.text: He was slain there along with his kinsman Frerin, and many others. After the battle his body was burned on a wooden pyre along with the rest of the dead.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "Durin's Folk"

claims.text: Years later, his sons, as members of Thorin and Company, were involved with the regaining of Lonely Mountain. Roäc recognised Balin as the son of Fundin.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Hobbit, "The Gathering of the Clouds"
